title: RFC 7807 Error Simulation
description: Test the application's professional error handling and interceptors by triggering real backend failures.

validation.title: Validation Error (400)
validation.subtitle: Field-level failures
validation.description: Simulates a request that fails validation on the backend. It returns multiple field errors (e.g., email, login) which are mapped to professional toasts.
validation.tooltip: Triggers 400 Bad Request with fieldErrors array

business.title: Business Logic (400)
business.subtitle: BadRequestAlertException
business.description: Simulates a business rule violation detected by Quarkus. It uses the JHipster-style alert pattern to show a specific error key/message.

server.title: Internal Error (500)
server.subtitle: Unexpected failure
server.description: Simulates a generic 500 error. The global interceptor should catch this and show a fallback 'Unexpected error' message to the user.

envelope.title: Envelope Pattern
envelope.subtitle: BaseResponse Unwrapping
envelope.description: Simulates a successful response wrapped in a { data, message, code } envelope. The BaseResponseInterceptor should transparently unwrap the data.
